dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and rapid narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle, forming a sharp V-shaped geometric taper.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Visible lateral margins are largely smooth and convex, with slight irregular masking due to water turbulence at the peripheral edges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the entire visible dorsal surface with minimal pixel variance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Very low density; localized grey shading is limited to a small patch anterior to the blowhole and a faint longitudinal shadow along the dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; the gradient between the white skin and the few visible grey areas is soft and lacks sharp defined edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast dark-grey spot is located on the left-lateral side slightly posterior to the blowhole.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A prominent, straight longitudinal crease or indentation is visible along the central dorsal axis, extending from the mid-back toward the tail.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, dark pigmented mark near the blowhole; a distinct linear structural depression along the lower dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is a high-contrast, dark circular aperture located centrally on the anterior portion of the visible dorsal plane.
